name: Camp Moosilauke
description_short: A traditional overnight camp for boys ages 7-15 on a New Hampshire lake, founded in 1904. Campers do land sports, waterfront and outdoor adventure activities, with set periods in the morning and activities they pick each afternoon.
refund_policy_summary: A $1,000 registration deposit is due at enrollment and becomes non-refundable after December 1, 2026. The page gives no other refund terms.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp has a private waterfront and swimming area and about a mile of shoreline. Water activities include swimming, canoeing, kayaking, sailing, waterskiing/wakeboarding/wake surfing, rowing, stand-up paddle boarding and fishing.

warnings: OLD SEASON: This page only gives 2023 dates and tuition. The page says 'Dates and Rates Available for Summer 2027' and links to https://moosilauke.com/about-us/sessions-dates-tuition/. Check that page for current figures before relying on anything here.

Session prices are tuition only. The page lists a registration deposit 'plus' tuition ($1,000 for 4-1/2 week, $500 for other sessions). It is not clear whether the deposit is extra or counts toward tuition.
There is also a Counselor-in-Training program, priced at $4,350 (4-1/2 week) and $2,525 (2-1/2 week) in 2023. The page gives no CIT dates or ages, so it is not listed as a session.
The page says ACA accredited: check it on acacamps.org and add aca_accredited with aca_source_url
